_source: Hand reading of Fig. 4.1 of Smith, Myers, Kaplan, Goodman-Strauss, A chiral aperiodic monotile (Combinatorial Theory 4(2) 2024, #13, p. 13): for each cluster, the six edge labels in anticlockwise order as printed, starting with the segment that leaves the leftmost marked dot. Letters: a alpha, b beta, g gamma, d delta, e epsilon, z zeta, h eta, t theta.
